description: Initialize the monorepo structure with pnpm workspaces, TypeScript configuration, ESLint, Prettier, and all package scaffolding. This establishes the foundational project structure that all subsequent features build upon.
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspace configuration, scripts for build/test/lint/dev
Create pnpm-workspace.yaml defining apps/* and packages/* workspaces
Create turbo.json for build pipeline orchestration with proper task dependencies
Create root tsconfig.json with strict TypeScript settings and path aliases
Create .eslintrc.js with TypeScript and React rules
Create .gitignore for Node.js, Next.js, AWS CDK, and IDE files
Create .env.example with all required environment variables documented
Scaffold apps/web as a Next.js 14 app with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS - include package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.js, tailwind.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx
Scaffold apps/api as the serverless backend - package.json, tsconfig.json, serverless.yml (Serverless Framework config), src/handlers/ directory with a health-check Lambda handler

Scaffold packages/shared with package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts - include types for multi-tenant context (TenantContext, UserRole, etc.), DPI types (APAAR, DigiLocker, ABC interfaces), and utility functions
Scaffold packages/ui as a React component library - package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, src/components/Button.tsx as example
Scaffold packages/ai as the AI service abstraction layer - package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts with interfaces for LearningPathEngine, AITutor, ContentGenerator
Scaffold infrastructure/ as AWS CDK app - package.json, tsconfig.json, bin/app.ts, lib/ directory with placeholder stacks for Auth, Database, API, Storage
Create tests/ directory for Playwright E2E tests - package.json with @playwright/test dependency, playwright.config.ts configured for the web app
Create docs/ directory with ARCHITECTURE.md documenting the system design, modules, and data flow
Create README.md with project overview, setup instructions, architecture diagram references, and development workflow
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm install at root successfully installs all workspace dependencies
Running pnpm build compiles all TypeScript packages without errors
Running pnpm lint passes with no errors
The Next.js app in apps/web builds successfully
The serverless API in apps/api compiles without errors
All packages/shared, packages/ui, packages/ai compile without errors
Infrastructure CDK app synthesizes without errors
findings: nvm must be sourced for Node/pnpm access. All 7 packages build and lint. next-env.d.ts auto-generated by Next.js build. ESLint warns about React version in non-React packages but lint passes.
